description: Swiss National Council elections from the Federal Statistical Office (open data): for the latest election (2023) party strength in per cent of the vote with the change since the previous election, seats, women elected and turnout for Switzerland, every canton and every commune (communes in the boundaries SLI uses; merged communes add up the votes of their former communes, recomputed exactly); plus party strength and seats since 1991 for Switzerland and the cantons. With commune (name or BFS number), canton (2-letter code) or neither (Switzerland). history=true adds the series since 1991. Parties are shown as published (CVP and BDP until 2019, Die Mitte from 2023).

commune.description: commune name or BFS number, optional

history.description: include the series since 1991 (Switzerland or canton)

name: election_results
